about: Partly covered. A heater broken since 2026-09-15 (repair_not_made, covered) and a landlord's remark about the tenant's religion and refusal to renew (discrimination, not covered). Expected: the model loads repair_not_made and no other skill, and the chat goes on for the repair; asked about the remark, it says the tool has no skill for that, has nothing to quote, and cites no law from memory.

start.description: My heater hasn't worked since September 15, 2026 and my landlord keeps saying he'll fix it but he doesn't. I rent a house in Gainesville. When I asked him about it again he said he regrets renting to 'people like you' because I'm Muslim, and now he says he won't renew my lease. I have kept paying rent. I have not put anything in writing to him about the heater, nothing anyone did broke it that I know of, and no court papers have come.

chat: Is it illegal for him to say that about my religion?
Can he refuse to renew my lease because I complained about the heater?
